hero.description: Accelerate your development with Omni-tRPC-Stack. A high-performance architecture seamlessly integrating Next.js, Nest.js, and Expo with 100% Type-Safety.

truth.title: Single Source of Truth
truth.desc: Forget about duplicating validation logic. Use Shared Zod schemas across Web, Mobile, and Server simultaneously.

safety.title: E2E Type-Safety
safety.desc: Experience the magic of tRPC. Catch API breaking changes at compile time before they ever reach production.

mobile.title: Native Mobile
mobile.desc: Not just a web-wrapper. A fully-fledged Expo app is baked in, sharing logic and state out of the box.

devops.title: DevOps-as-a-Service
devops.desc: Industrial-grade deployment. From Docker orchestration to automated GitHub Actions CI/CD for your VPS.

security.title: Advanced Security
security.desc: Full 2FA with backup codes, RBAC, and secure session management pre-configured for production.
